entry.title: New: Resolution 270 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HE HO‘OMAKA HOU ANA O‘ PUNA TO SUPPORT THE HAWAI‘I COMMUNITY COLLEGE’S ‘AUAMO KULEANA DOMESTIC VIOLENCE SUMMIT

Transfers $2,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 2)
